propositions: T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments via an exact scope clause stating the exclusion boundary.

The scope clause must be immediately followed by a co-located exact safety qualifier preserving four MAJOR classes: destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secret, and untrusted-network endpoint auth for transient infrastructure.
T10 must remain independent and not name T15 or delegate scope to other overlays.

Packaged eval spec requires ten balanced dataset cases: five pass scenarios (scoped teardown, fully specified durable, private-network IAM, secret-manager, sandbox teardown) and five finding scenarios (under-specified lifecycle, destructive transient apply, wildcard-admin transient, plaintext-secret transient, untrusted-network transient service).
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence without cross-criterion delegation.
Live criterion eval must demonstrate correct behavior across all ten cases with stable results across multiple runs, with generated guide and rebar explain rendering both clauses.
